about: Next daily blog keywords, each locked to the money page it must lift. Take the first row whose status is "next", write it per docs/SEO_SYSTEM.md section 4, then set status to "published" and add the post to keyword-map.json as a support page with this target. Re-rank after each GSC report (scripts/seo/gsc-report.mjs). Language mix about 4 English to 1 Bahasa.
